title: STOP Buying ANDROID TV Boxes!
summary: Linus Tech Tips warns against cheap Android TV boxes, many of which ship with preinstalled malware. It looks at several boxes and suggests safer alternatives such as Chromecast and Nvidia Shield.
why: HN cites it as broad, accessible evidence that cheap Android TV boxes often come loaded with malware.

quote.text: found many cheap Android TV boxes were infested with malware
